title: Is your custom software secure? Security and GDPR essentials for business owners

points.heading: Security is a baseline, not a feature
points.body: The most expensive misunderstanding in software is treating security as something you add later, like a feature.

points.heading: GDPR: what actually applies to your software
points.body: If your software touches personal data — names, emails, customer records, employee data, anything that identifies a person — the GDPR (in Dutch: AVG) applies.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
cta.sub: Security and GDPR aren't optional in custom software.
